working_definition: Author cell type 'enteroblast' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00110205 'enteroblast'. Found in: 10x:gut (202 cells), ss2:gut (23 cells).
searches_performed: 'adult enteroblast' (exact label / exact synonym, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Non-proliferative cell that arises from the division of an intestinal stem cell in the adult midgut and is committed to differentiate into an enterocyte (Zeng and Hou, 2015; He et al., 2018; Reiff et al., 2019).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00110205 'enteroblast', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00110205 'enteroblast', exact match.
